name: one-arm-standing-hammer-curl.html
instructions:
1. Set up by grasping a dumbbell and standing straight up with the dumbbell by your side.
2. You should be using a neutral grip, meaning the palm of your hand is facing your body. You can use your other arm to stabilize the body.
3. Take up the "slack" by bending your arm slightly. This is the starting position.
4. Slowly curl the dumbbell up as far as possible.
5. Squeeze the bicep at the top of the movement, and then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
6. Repeat this movement with the other arm.
